SELECT synthetic_automations.id, synthetic_automations.enabled, synthetic_automations.deleted_at, synthetic_automations.last_polled_at 
FROM synthetic_automations 
WHERE synthetic_automations.enabled IS true AND synthetic_automations.deleted_at IS NULL AND (synthetic_automations.last_polled_at IS NULL OR synthetic_automations.last_polled_at < %(last_polled_at_1)s) ORDER BY synthetic_automations.last_polled_at ASC NULLS FIRST 
 LIMIT %(param_1)s FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
